title: Toddler and cat share sibling rivalry vibes as playful moment unfolds at home
description:
The cat featured in this video seems to understand perfectly that those who love you the most often annoy you the most.

"My toddler loved our cat when we got her as a kitten, but as she’s gotten older, they fight just like siblings," the filmer, Megan, told WooGlobe.

The cat makes it clear to her human sibling that he is lucky to have both a mischievous sibling and an adorable pet rolled into one.

There is no doubt that many more moments like this lie ahead as the two continue growing up together.
